name: Mabel Charron
source:
As the headmaster’s daughter, Mabel is the star pupil, model student, and pride and joy of the academy. She exudes calm elegance and maternal comfort, never raising her voice or getting into arguments. The president of the gardening club, she is always willing to help out a peer in need. 

Despite her mature composure, gentle kindness, and sweet generosity, Mabel has an immature side. She is secretly pushy, possessive, and demanding. She is prone to bouts of intense jealousy, and refuses to accept rejection. Groom.
